jumping.reason: Planted feet match the user-approved hover redesign; visible closed-eye smile; head/body and costume stay coherent; neutral endpoints.

waiting.reason: Both open palms rise and return together; no switching handedness, clipping or visible volume pop.

running.reason: Hand near chin/collar combined with downward attention reads as thinking; neutral final pose matches idle.
running.note: One half-closed-eye pose can look mildly sleepy; accepted in the full thinking sequence. This is processing, not locomotion.

review.reason: Same screen-right hand gives thumbs-up, opposite hand stays low; smile and neutral endpoints remain coherent.

limitations: The image viewer displayed only the first GIF frame. Reviewers inspected every ordered pose in the contact sheet; no real-time desktop playback test is claimed.
Desktop selection and task-triggered animation behavior still require local user trial.
inherited_direction_notes: Two near-up intermediate micro-cue warnings remain accepted from v1.2. Those pixels are unchanged.
